samples.summary: `skipRunBackgrounds` now has no caller anywhere in the repo, and its doc still names DocCanvas as the caller
samples.evidence: Repo-wide grep for `skipRunBackgrounds:` finds no call site — the three `paintLayout` callers all omit it (packages/slides/src/view/canvas/text-renderer.ts:244, packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:599, and the docs tests). DocCanvas never calls `paintLayout` at all: it drives its own pass at packages/docs/src/view/doc-canvas.ts:416 and its own `renderRun` loop at doc-canvas.ts:566-570. With `paintBlock` now hardcoding `skipBackground: true`, the option's only remaining effect is suppressing step 1, and the PaintLayoutOpts doc (paint-layout.ts:50-57) plus the module header (paint-layout.ts:12-18) describe a pipeline/consumer that does not exist. Fix belongs on the new code: either delete the option or correct the doc.

samples.summary: Header/footer runs still get per-run rects, so the justify half of #1036 is unfixed there while body/table now band
samples.evidence: `renderRunWithPageNumber` (packages/docs/src/view/doc-canvas.ts:706-726) is the only remaining consumer of `renderRun`'s `skipBackground: false` path. The diff gives that path both-edges rounding (fixing the sub-pixel seam) but no line-level coalescing, so a justified header/footer paragraph — where `applyAlignment('justify')` shifts `run.x` without growing `run.width` — keeps the multi-pixel inter-word gaps the body path no longer has. `renderHeaderFooterBlocks` (doc-canvas.ts:737+) walks lines and could call the new `drawInlineRunBackgroundsForLine`; nothing in the repo does. The task doc scopes header/footer to rounding only (docs/tasks/active/20260907-docs-highlight-gaps-todo.md:36-37), so this may be deliberate — but the two surfaces now disagree visually.

samples.summary: PDF export still paints per-segment highlight rects with raw widths, so exported PDFs no longer match the on-screen band
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/export/pdf-painter.ts:758-767 draws one rectangle per text segment at `px2pt(xpx)` with `segWidthPt`, and pdf-table-painter.ts handles only cell backgrounds — neither routes through `drawInlineRunBackgroundsForLine`, so justify/word-boundary gaps persist in export while the canvas now shows one continuous band. The task doc declares this out of scope (docs/tasks/active/20260907-docs-highlight-gaps-todo.md:45-48), so the finding is the screen/export divergence this change introduces, not a broken call site.

samples.summary: `renderTableContent` doc still claims it draws inline run backgrounds
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/table-renderer.ts:240-245: "Second pass of the table render pipeline: draw cell text (including inline run backgrounds)" — the content pass paints no inline backgrounds; they are emitted solely by `renderTableBackgrounds` (now via `drawInlineRunBackgroundsForLine` at table-renderer.ts:223). The diff updated the sibling comment at 188-195 but left this one describing the old contract.
